question: __________ is the main festival of Karnataka, which marks the Kannada new year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ugadi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ugadi** is celebrated as the Kannada New Year and is one of the most important festivals in Karnataka.
 
• It is observed on the first day of the Chaitra month in the Hindu lunisolar calendar, which usually falls in March or April.
 
• Ugadi signifies the beginning of a new era and is a time for people to clean their homes, prepare special dishes, and perform religious rituals to welcome the new year.
 
• Traditional foods such as "Bevu-Bella" (a mixture of neem and jaggery) are consumed to symbolize the acceptance of both bitter and sweet experiences in life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sri vitappa**

 
 
• Vitappa is a deity and the festival associated with it, Sri Vitappa fair, is celebrated in the state of Karnataka, but it is not the Kannada New Year.
 
• This festival is specific to the worship of the deity Vitappa and includes fairs, processions, and various cultural activities.
 
 
 
• **Hampi**
 
 
• Hampi is a historic village in Karnataka, renowned for its ancient temples and ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire.
 
• While Hampi is a significant cultural and historical site, it is not related to the Kannada New Year celebration.
 
 
 
• **Basava Jayanti**
 
 
• Basava Jayanti is celebrated in honor of Basavanna, a philosopher and statesman who founded the Lingayat sect.
 
• This festival is important in Karnataka but does not mark the Kannada New Year.
